subject: Change rdbSaveStreamConsumers return type from size_t to ssize_t (#3499)
reason: The change only alters the declared return type of rdbSaveStreamConsumers from size_t to ssize_t. The function already returned -1 on error and its sole caller assigns the result to an ssize_t and compares with -1; the previous implicit size_t/ssize_t conversions round-tripped -1 unchanged on all supported platforms, so error detection, the RDB bytes written, and all observable behaviour are identical. This is a pure type-correctness refactor with no behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
